items.q: I was in St. Louis when I met Fate Marable.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
No, I didn't, I was in St. Louis when I met Fate Marable. I can't recall the famous names but I remember Fate, but that was a big name then. Louis was with him.
